audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar scouting-of-Canaan text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for scout commission, tribal representatives, renaming of Hoshea/Joshua, land and produce report, fortified cities, Caleb's minority report, and fear rhetoric about Anakim/Nephilim. Strong anti-colonial, anti-racist, and anti-dehumanization safeguards required.

original.text: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָת֣וּר אֶת הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה לְהוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן נ֖וּן יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ

verses.restored: Moses sent them to scout land of Canaan and said to them, Go up this way through Negev and go up into hill country.

familiar.text: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

modern.text: When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, he told them, “Go up through the Negev and into the hill country.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֹתָם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָת֖וּר אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם עֲל֥וּ זֶה֙ בַּנֶּ֔גֶב וַעֲלִיתֶ֖ם אֶת הָהָֽר

verses.restored: See what land is, and people dwelling upon it, whether strong or weak, whether few or many;

familiar.text: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

modern.text: See what the land is like and whether its people are strong or weak, few or many.

original.text: וּרְאִיתֶ֥ם אֶת הָאָ֖רֶץ מַה הִ֑וא וְאֶת הָעָם֙ הַיֹּשֵׁ֣ב עָלֶ֔יהָ הֶחָזָ֥ק הוּא֙ הֲרָפֶ֔ה הַמְעַ֥ט ה֖וּא אִם רָֽב

verses.restored: and what land is in which they dwell, whether good or bad; and what cities are in which they dwell, whether camps or fortifications;

familiar.text: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

modern.text: Is the land where they live good or bad? Are the cities where they dwell open camps or fortifications?

original.text: וּמָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔הּ הֲטוֹבָ֥ה הִ֖וא אִם רָעָ֑ה וּמָ֣ה הֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר הוּא֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּהֵ֔נָּה הַבְּמַֽחֲנִ֖ים אִ֥ם בְּמִבְצָרִֽים

verses.restored: and what land is, whether fat or lean, whether there are trees in it or not. Strengthen yourselves and take from fruit of land. Now days were days of first-ripe grapes.

familiar.text: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

modern.text: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous, and bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)

original.text: וּמָ֣ה הָ֠אָרֶץ הַשְּׁמֵנָ֨ה הִ֜וא אִם רָזָ֗ה הֲיֵֽשׁ בָּ֥הּ עֵץ֙ אִם אַ֔יִן וְהִ֨תְחַזַּקְתֶּ֔ם וּלְקַחְתֶּ֖ם מִפְּרִ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהַ֨יָּמִ֔ים יְמֵ֖י בִּכּוּרֵ֥י עֲנָבִֽים

verses.restored: They went up and scouted land from wilderness of Zin to Rehob, toward entrance of Hamath.

familiar.text: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

modern.text: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo-hamath.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ וַיָּתֻ֣רוּ אֶת הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמִּדְבַּר צִ֥ן עַד רְחֹ֖ב לְבֹ֥א חֲמָֽת

verses.restored: They went up through Negev and came to Hebron, and there were Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, descendants of Anak. Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

familiar.text: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

modern.text: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, dwelled. It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

original.text: וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בַנֶּגֶב֮ וַיָּבֹ֣א עַד חֶבְרוֹן֒ וְשָׁ֤ם אֲחִימַן֙ שֵׁשַׁ֣י וְתַלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָ֑ק וְחֶבְר֗וֹן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ נִבְנְתָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י צֹ֥עַן מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: They came to wadi of Eshcol and cut from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they carried it on a pole by two, with pomegranates and figs.

familiar.text: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

modern.text: When they came to the Valley of Eshcol, they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men. They also took some pomegranates and figs.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עַד נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֗ל וַיִּכְרְת֨וּ מִשָּׁ֤ם זְמוֹרָה֙ וְאֶשְׁכּ֤וֹל עֲנָבִים֙ אֶחָ֔ד וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֥הוּ בַמּ֖וֹט בִּשְׁנָ֑יִם וּמִן הָרִמֹּנִ֖ים וּמִן הַתְּאֵנִֽים

verses.restored: That place was called wadi Eshcol/Cluster because of cluster children of Israel cut from there.

familiar.text: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

modern.text: Because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut there, that place was called the Valley of Eshcol. The Reports of the Spies

original.text: לַמָּק֣וֹם הַה֔וּא קָרָ֖א נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֑וֹל עַ֚ל אֹד֣וֹת הָֽאֶשְׁכּ֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר כָּרְת֥וּ מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: They returned from scouting land at end of forty days.

familiar.text: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

modern.text: After forty days the men returned from spying out the land,

original.text: וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מִתּ֣וּר הָאָ֑רֶץ מִקֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יֽוֹם

verses.restored: They went and came to Moses and Aaron and all congregation of children of Israel, to wilderness of Paran at Kadesh; they brought back word to them and all congregation and showed them fruit of land.

familiar.text: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

modern.text: and they went back to Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh. They brought back a report for the whole congregation and showed them the fruit of the land.

original.text: וַיֵּלְכ֡וּ וַיָּבֹאוּ֩ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל כָּל עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל מִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָ֖ן קָדֵ֑שָׁה וַיָּשִׁ֨יבוּ אוֹתָ֤ם דָּבָר֙ וְאֶת כָּל הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַיַּרְא֖וּם אֶת פְּרִ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: They recounted to him and said, We came to land where you sent us; indeed it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

familiar.text: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

modern.text: And they gave this account to Moses: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey. Here is some of its fruit!

original.text: וַיְסַפְּרוּ לוֹ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בָּ֕אנוּ אֶל הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְ֠גַם זָבַ֨ת חָלָ֥ב וּדְבַ֛שׁ הִ֖וא וְזֶה פִּרְיָֽהּ

verses.restored: Nevertheless, people dwelling in land are strong, cities fortified and very great; moreover descendants of Anak we saw there.

familiar.text: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

modern.text: Nevertheless, the people living in the land are strong, and the cities are large and fortified. We even saw the descendants of Anak there.

original.text: אֶ֚פֶס כִּֽי עַ֣ז הָעָ֔ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהֶֽעָרִ֗ים בְּצֻר֤וֹת גְּדֹלֹת֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְגַם יְלִדֵ֥י הָֽעֲנָ֖ק רָאִ֥ינוּ שָֽׁם

verses.restored: Amalek dwells in land of Negev; Hittite, Jebusite, and Amorite dwell in hill country; and Canaanite dwells by sea and along side of Jordan.

familiar.text: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

modern.text: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.”

original.text: עֲמָלֵ֥ק יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַנֶּ֑גֶב וְ֠הַֽחִתִּי וְהַיְבוּסִ֤י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּהָ֔ר וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב עַל הַיָּ֔ם וְעַ֖ל יַ֥ד הַיַּרְדֵּֽן

verses.restored: Caleb quieted people before Moses and said, Surely we should go up and possess it, for surely we are able to prevail over it.

familiar.text: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

modern.text: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, “We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!”

original.text: וַיַּ֧הַס כָּלֵ֛ב אֶת הָעָ֖ם אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר עָלֹ֤ה נַעֲלֶה֙ וְיָרַ֣שְׁנוּ אֹתָ֔הּ כִּֽי יָכ֥וֹל נוּכַ֖ל לָֽהּ

verses.restored: But men who went up with him said, We are not able to go up against people, for they are stronger than we.

familiar.text: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

modern.text: But the men who had gone up with him replied, “We cannot go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are!”

original.text: וְהָ֨אֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶׁר עָל֤וּ עִמּוֹ֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לַעֲל֣וֹת אֶל הָעָ֑ם כִּֽי חָזָ֥ק ה֖וּא מִמֶּֽנּוּ

verses.restored: They brought out an evil report of land that they had scouted to children of Israel, saying, Land through which we passed to scout it is a land eating its inhabitants, and all people whom we saw in its midst are men of great measure.

familiar.text: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

modern.text: So they gave the Israelites a bad report about the land that they had spied out: “The land we explored devours its inhabitants, and all the people we saw there are great in stature.

original.text: וַיּוֹצִ֜יאוּ דִּבַּ֤ת הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּר֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבַ֨רְנוּ בָ֜הּ לָת֣וּר אֹתָ֗הּ אֶ֣רֶץ אֹכֶ֤לֶת יוֹשְׁבֶ֨יהָ֙ הִ֔וא וְכָל הָעָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר רָאִ֥ינוּ בְתוֹכָ֖הּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִדּֽוֹת

verses.restored: There we saw Nephilim—sons of Anak are from Nephilim—and we were in our own eyes like grasshoppers, and so we were in their eyes.

familiar.text: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

modern.text: We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim! We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight, and we must have seemed the same to them!”

original.text: וְשָׁ֣ם רָאִ֗ינוּ אֶת הַנְּפִילִ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ק מִן הַנְּפִלִ֑ים וַנְּהִ֤י בְעֵינֵ֨ינוּ֙ כַּֽחֲגָבִ֔ים וְכֵ֥ן הָיִ֖ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיהֶֽם

translation_notes: The scouting mission belongs to an ancient conquest narrative. It must not be used to justify modern colonization, ethnic cleansing, land seizure, or displacement.
The inhabitants are named peoples with homes and cities; they must not be flattened into obstacles or racialized monsters.
Verse 16 preserves Hoshea's renaming as Joshua/Yehoshua.
The report moves from observable facts—fruit, population, fortifications—to fear-laden interpretation.
Nephilim and Anakim language is ancient giant/legendary-warrior rhetoric and requires lexical and reception-history audit.
'We were like grasshoppers' is the scouts' self-perception and projected assumption about others, not an objective statement of human worth.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 13 to sanctify conquest, colonial expansion, racism, forced displacement, or dehumanization of indigenous peoples. Preserve the ancient narrative while distinguishing observation from fear-amplified rhetoric and refusing modern territorial weaponization.
